purpose: Reuse existing BOOM ledgers for BDIF evidence, decisions, runs, outcomes and learning before considering any migration.

hunt_boom_decisions.status_semantics: Keep existing approval workflow status separate from BDIF selected outcome.
hunt_boom_decisions.bdif_storage: Store canonical BDIF envelope inside proposed_action.bdif_decision and/or result.bdif_decision; do not overload status with PASS/REVIEW/REJECT.

hunt_boom_learning_items.rule: testing/learned never silently changes production behavior

invariants: No schema migration in Phase B unless existing JSON/evidence fields prove insufficient.
Decision evidence and actual outcome must retain correlation lineage.
Raw credentials, payment data, addresses, email and phone are excluded from BDIF evidence payloads.
Owner override is recorded but is not automatically treated as ground truth.
